_readme: Edit this file to add songs. Each song has: title, optional author and singer, number, book, edition, and sections (each with a label and a list of lines). To repeat a chorus without retyping it, give sections an id and add an 'order' list of ids, e.g. "order": ["v1", "c", "v2", "c"]. On the lyrics pages, keys 1-9 jump to 'Verse 1'-'Verse 9' (found from the label, or add "verse": 2 to a section), and C or 0 jumps to the chorus (a section whose label contains 'Chorus' or 'Refrain', or that has "kind": "chorus"). The three songs below are SAMPLES (public-domain English hymns); replace them and the book/edition with your own.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found;
Was blind, but now I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Through many dangers, toils and snares,
I have already come;
'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The Lord has promised good to me,
His word my hope secures;
He will my shield and portion be,
As long as life endures.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, holy, holy! merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy, holy, holy! all the saints adore Thee,
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and seraphim falling down before Thee,
Which wert, and art, and evermore shalt be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy, holy, holy! though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see,
Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee,
Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise Thy name, in earth, and sky, and sea;
Holy, holy, holy! merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour all the day long;
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour all the day long.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
Angels descending bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Perfect submission, all is at rest,
I in my Saviour am happy and blest,
Watching and waiting, looking above,
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love.
